onset.Description: Start of one sequence (epoch) in this file: (sequence - 1) x EpochLength (sequences back-to-back)

trial_type.Description: Every events.tsv holds exactly one row per sequence (epoch) of the data file (since 18 Oct 2026), so that readers of epoched data (mne_bids.read_epochs_bids) load each file as its sequences. The stimulus-level Letswave events are in derivatives/stimulus_events/ (README, 'Events and epochs').

Levels.sequence_start: Start of one sequence (epoch) of the file; not a stimulus event

latency_in_sequence.Description: Time of the epoch start on the Letswave sequence time axis (= SequenceStartTime in ieeg.json when given; n/a otherwise)

sample.Description: First sample of the sequence in this file (0-based) = (sequence - 1) x round(EpochLength x SamplingFrequency)
